text:
To: All Regional Managers
From: Daniela Ortiz, Logistics Director
Subject: Revised delivery schedule

Following last week's port strike, shipments of seasonal inventory will reach our distribution center roughly ten days later than [1]. [2] Stores that depend on these items for the holiday promotion should therefore review their floor plans immediately. Our freight partner has assured us that the backlog at the terminal is being cleared strictly in order of arrival. The delay is regrettable. [3], it does not affect regular orders, which remain on the original timetable. We are also negotiating with a second carrier so that a comparable disruption would [4] our stores far less in the future. Please direct questions about individual orders to the logistics help desk before Friday.

questions.explanation: 'later than planned' needs the past participle, as in 'than expected'.

choices: Regular stock will continue to be shipped from the secondary warehouse in the northern region.
The affected merchandise includes winter apparel, gift sets, and decorative lighting for the display windows.
Several managers have already asked whether the strike could be extended into the following month.
Carriers have been informed that late arrivals will no longer be accepted at the receiving docks after six p.m.
questions.explanation: 'these items' in the next sentence needs an antecedent; only the correct choice names the delayed seasonal goods.
The sentence adds a contrast: the delay is regrettable, but regular orders are not affected.
'Affect' is the verb meaning to influence; 'effect' is normally a noun.

text:
NOTICE TO RESIDENTS
Hawthorne Court Apartments

The building's heating system will undergo a scheduled upgrade between October 14 and October 18. During this period, hot water will be [1] between 9 a.m. and 3 p.m. each day. [2] Residents who rely on early-morning showers are advised to adjust their routines accordingly. Engineers will need access to each unit to inspect the radiators, so tenants are asked to ensure that the areas around them are [3]. If you will not be at home, please leave a key with the front desk by October 12. Management apologizes for any inconvenience and is confident that the improvements will [4] energy costs by roughly fifteen percent over the winter.

questions.explanation: Water cut off during set hours is 'unavailable'; the other adjectives do not describe supply.

choices: The new boilers will be delivered by truck on the morning of October 14 and lifted into the basement.
Outside those hours, the supply will operate at normal capacity, and the heating will stay on.
The front desk will remain open during the work and will be able to take messages for residents.
The utility company has announced that gas prices will rise sharply once the winter season begins.
questions.explanation: The sentence completes the information about the daily interruption and explains what happens outside the 9 to 3 window.
'are clear' is an adjective after 'to ensure that ... are'; the adverb or gerund would not fit.
Better heating efficiency would 'reduce' energy costs.

text:
IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR PASSENGERS
Coastal Ferry Lines

Due to forecast high winds on Wednesday, the 7:15 a.m. and 9:45 a.m. departures from Port Ellis have been canceled. [1] The 12:30 p.m. sailing will operate as scheduled unless conditions worsen, in which case an announcement will be made at the terminal. Passengers holding tickets for the canceled services may [2] travel to a later date without charge or request a full refund. [3] Vehicle reservations, a refund will be issued automatically to the card used for payment. Passengers who have already checked in their luggage should collect it from the baggage hall before leaving the terminal. We recommend that you [4] our website or call the information line before setting out, as services may change at short notice. We regret any inconvenience this may cause.

choices: Customers who need to reach the island urgently are advised to join the afternoon sailing, which has additional capacity.
The ferry fleet was inspected last month and found to meet every one of the safety standards required by the authorities.
Winds of this strength are unusual for the time of year and are expected to subside by Thursday morning.
The terminal café will remain open until the last sailing and offers a range of hot drinks and meals.
questions.explanation: The next sentence is about the 12:30 sailing, so the preceding sentence should point passengers to it.
Tickets can be 'transferred' to another date; the others do not collocate with 'travel to a later date'.
The refund rule applies to vehicle reservations as a specific case.
One 'consults' a website for information.

text:
Dear Valued Customer,

At Greenfield Insurance, we are committed to providing coverage that evolves with your needs. After reviewing your policy, we have identified several changes that will take effect on January 1. [1] Your annual premium will increase by 3 percent, which is lower than the average rise across the industry. [2], your coverage limit for personal belongings will rise from $20,000 to $25,000, at no extra cost. We have also simplified the claims process: you can now submit a claim [3] through our mobile app, and you will receive a decision within five business days. If you have questions about any of these changes, our advisers are available to [4] you through them by telephone or in person at any of our branches. Thank you for your continued loyalty.

Margaret Doyle
Customer Relations Manager

choices: We would like to explain these changes clearly so that you can decide whether your policy still suits you.
Many of our customers have told us that they are pleased with the speed at which their claims have been handled lately.
Greenfield Insurance was named best regional insurer by an independent consumer organization last year.
Policyholders who wish to cancel their coverage must give written notice at least one month in advance.
questions.explanation: The sentence introduces the explanation of changes, preceding the details of premium and coverage.
'However' marks the contrast between the premium rise and the increase in coverage, which is a benefit.
An adverb is needed to modify the verb 'submit'.
Advisers 'guide' customers through changes.

text:
Subject: Changes to the Dunmore Museum membership program

Dear Members,

After extensive consultation with visitors, the board has decided to restructure the museum's membership program from the start of next year. [1] Annual membership fees will remain unchanged for individuals, but family memberships will rise by $10 to cover the cost of the new children's workshops. [2] all members will receive priority booking for special exhibitions, a benefit previously reserved for the highest tier. In return, the free guest passes that members once enjoyed will be discontinued, since they were [3] used. We understand that some of you may be disappointed by this change, and we would welcome your comments before the new rules take effect. Feedback can be [4] by e-mail to membership@dunmore.example until December 15.

Warm regards,
The Membership Team

choices: The new structure is intended to attract younger visitors while preserving the benefits regular supporters value most.
The museum has acquired a collection of eighteenth-century maps that will be displayed in the east gallery.
Attendance last year was the highest recorded since the building was reopened following the major renovation.
The board includes representatives from local universities, businesses, and several community organizations.
questions.explanation: The next sentence provides detail on fees; the correct option offers the overall rationale before the details.
The sentence adds another change to those already mentioned.
The passes were discontinued because they were 'rarely' used; other adverbs do not justify removal.
The passive 'can be submitted' requires the past participle.

text:
Dear Parents and Guardians,

The annual school trip to the National Science Museum will take place on Friday, October 3. Students in grades eight and nine will leave by coach at 8 a.m. and return at approximately 4 p.m. [1] Each student should bring a packed lunch, a water bottle, and a notebook for the activities planned by the museum's education team. The cost of the trip, $18 per student, [2] the entrance fee and transport. Payment should be made by Friday, September 19, using the school's online system. [3] you do not wish your child to participate, please inform the school office in writing, and an alternative program will be arranged. Students are expected to behave [4] and to follow the instructions of the accompanying teachers at all times.

Yours faithfully,
Mrs. Janet Okoro
Head of Science

choices: Because the group is large, students will be divided into four smaller groups, each led by a teacher.
The museum has recently added a new gallery devoted to space exploration and renewable energy sources.
Last year's trip to the planetarium was enjoyed by nearly all of the students who took part in it.
The science department has purchased new equipment for the laboratories, including twenty microscopes.
questions.explanation: The next sentence tells students what to bring, so the preceding sentence sets out the organization of the day.
The fee 'covers' (includes) the entrance fee and transport.
'Should you not wish' style inversion; here 'Should' means 'If', followed by the request to inform the office.
An adverb is needed to modify the verb 'behave'.

text:
To: Warehouse Supervisors
From: Marcus Obi, Safety Officer
Subject: New forklift procedures

Following two minor accidents in the loading area last month, new forklift procedures will come into force on Monday. [1] Only employees who hold a current certificate may operate a forklift, and certificates will be checked at the start of every shift. [2] Pedestrians must keep out of the marked lanes, and anyone who needs to cross them must wait until the driver has signaled that it is safe to do so. A speed limit of five miles per hour will [3] throughout the building. Supervisors are asked to [4] these rules at their next team meeting and to report any breach to my office immediately. A refresher course for drivers is planned for the end of the month.

choices: The aim of the changes is to separate vehicles from people wherever possible and to make drivers accountable.
The warehouse handles around four thousand pallets a week, a volume that has nearly doubled since last year.
The company has ordered three new electric forklifts, which are expected to be delivered sometime next spring.
Neither of the accidents resulted in a serious injury, though one pallet of goods was badly damaged.
questions.explanation: The sentences that follow set out specific rules, so the preceding sentence gives the aim of the procedures.
The sentence adds a second rule to the first.
After 'will', the base form is needed; 'apply' means the limit is enforced.
Supervisors should 'emphasize' (stress) the rules to their teams.

text:
Senior Data Analyst – Castellan Logistics

Castellan Logistics, a global freight forwarder, seeks a Senior Data Analyst to lead a team of four in our Rotterdam office. [1] The successful candidate will transform complex operational data into clear recommendations for senior management. [2] A master's degree in statistics or a related field is required, together with five years of experience in a similar role. Fluency in English and Dutch is [3], as is the ability to explain technical findings to non-specialists. We provide a competitive salary, relocation assistance, and the chance to [4] a team that is shaping the future of the industry. Interested applicants should submit their CV and a cover letter by December 1.

choices: This position reports directly to the Chief Operating Officer and plays a central role in strategic planning.
Castellan Logistics operates in forty countries and moves goods valued at several billion euros every year.
Our Rotterdam office was recently relocated to a modern building near the harbor and the central station.
The department has grown rapidly and now uses advanced software to track shipments in real time.
questions.explanation: The next sentence describes what the candidate will do; the correct choice introduces the position's standing.

choices: The company will pay for professional training and for membership of relevant associations once the contract begins.
Experience of forecasting and of working with large data sets is particularly valued by the interview panel.
Relocation support includes help with finding housing and a contribution toward the cost of moving belongings.
Interviews will be held both online and in person, depending on where the applicants are living at that time.
questions.explanation: The next sentence sets the formal requirements; the preceding sentence signals the skills that matter.
An adjective is needed after 'is'; 'as is' links to a parallel requirement.
One 'joins' a team; 'enter' would not take 'a team' naturally.

text:
To: Project Leaders
From: Dr. Sunita Rao, Research Director
Subject: Budget submissions for next year

The budget cycle for the coming fiscal year will open on September 1. [1] Each project leader is asked to submit a proposal that sets out expected costs, staffing requirements, and anticipated outcomes. Because funding is limited, proposals will be evaluated according to their alignment with the strategic priorities approved by the board. [2] Projects that rely on external partners must include signed letters of support, [3] these cannot be considered. Submissions should be uploaded to the shared drive by October 14. I would [4] you to consult your finance officer before finalizing the figures, as several rules have changed since last year.

choices: This year, requests will be reviewed in a single round rather than in two stages as before.
The research department has grown by almost a quarter since the previous fiscal year began.
Last year's proposals were assessed by an external panel, whose report was shared with project leaders.
Several grants from public agencies will expire at the end of December and will not be renewed.
questions.explanation: The next sentence says 'Each project leader is asked to submit', so the first sentence frames the procedure.

choices: The board meets four times a year to review progress and approve changes to the research strategy.
Priority will be given to work that addresses sustainability and makes use of the existing laboratory facilities.
Our partners include two universities and a hospital, all of which have contributed funding in the past.
The finance department will be moving to the third floor of the building at the end of September.
questions.explanation: The next sentence refers to partners and support letters; the preceding sentence concerns how proposals are evaluated.
Without letters of support the proposals cannot be considered: 'otherwise'.
'I would urge you to' is the fixed formula requiring the base verb.

text:
A Quiet Revolution in Warehouse Design

The modern warehouse bears little resemblance to the dusty storerooms of the past. At the new distribution center in Hartlepool, robots carry shelves to human pickers, [1] walking distances that once accounted for most of a worker's day. [2] Managers claim that productivity has risen by nearly 60 percent since the system was installed. Not everyone is convinced, [3]. Union representatives point out that the pace of work is now dictated by machines, and that injuries from repetitive movements have in fact increased. The company says it is [4] its procedures in response. Observers expect other firms to follow suit if the gains prove to be sustainable.

questions.explanation: 'thereby eliminating' is the participle phrase giving the result of the robots' work.

choices: Robotic systems of this kind are produced by a small number of specialist firms based mainly in Europe and Asia.
The change has reduced the time needed to fill an order from several minutes to well under one minute.
The Hartlepool site opened last autumn and now employs about nine hundred people on three shifts.
Many online retailers have invested heavily in automation to meet customers' demand for next-day delivery.
questions.explanation: The next sentence reports productivity, which follows a statement of faster order filling.
The sentence introduces a contrast with the managers' claim; 'however' can sit at the end of the sentence.
The present continuous 'is reviewing' is needed after 'is'.

text: Good morning, Mr. Wilkins. This is Dr. Shapiro's office. We are calling to remind you of your appointment on Thursday at 11:15 a.m. [1] Please arrive ten minutes early to complete a short questionnaire. If you are taking any new medication, kindly bring a list. Unfortunately, the doctor has [2] a meeting that morning, so there is a chance the appointment may begin a little late. [3] this happens, our receptionist will let you know as soon as you arrive. To confirm your attendance, reply YES to this message. If you are [4] to attend, please call us at least a day in advance so that we can offer the slot to another patient.

choices: The consultation will be your first since the surgery, and the doctor will review the results of your latest tests.
Our clinic has recently moved to a new location on the opposite side of the park near the central library.
The parking area behind the building is reserved for patients and is open from seven in the morning.
Dr. Shapiro has been a specialist in this field for more than twenty years and has published several papers.
questions.explanation: The next sentence tells him what to do on arrival, so the preceding sentence gives the purpose of the appointment.
The doctor has 'been called into' a meeting means he has been summoned to it.
'Should this happen' is an inverted conditional meaning 'If this happens'.
'unable to attend' is the fixed expression for a person.

text:
To: Warehouse Team
From: Corinne Aldous, Inventory Control
Subject: Stocktake next week

Our annual stocktake will take place on Wednesday and Thursday of next week. [1] During these two days, no goods will be dispatched or received, and customers have been informed accordingly. Each team will be responsible for counting the items in its own section, [2] a second person will verify the figures. Counts must be entered on the handheld scanners as they are [3], not at the end of the shift, since errors are far more likely to occur when figures are recalled from memory. Anyone who notices damaged goods during the count should tag them [4] and report them to me. Refreshments will be provided in the break room throughout both days.

choices: The exercise is required by our auditors and must be completed before the end of the financial year.
Several staff members have asked whether overtime will be paid for work carried out during the stocktake.
The new scanners were delivered last week and have been tested by the team leaders in the loading area.
Last year's count revealed a discrepancy of less than one percent, which was considered excellent by the auditors.
questions.explanation: The next sentence describes conditions during the two days, so the preceding sentence explains the exercise.
The verification by a second person follows the first count.
'as they are made' is a passive construction with a past participle.
An adverb is needed to modify the verb 'tag'.

text:
Dear Ms. Nakamura,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding the lease of office space at Riverside Plaza. We currently have two suites available, [1] one on the fourth floor and one on the seventh. Both are fitted with air conditioning and high-speed cabling, and tenants have access to shared meeting rooms. [2] The fourth-floor suite offers 120 square meters and is available immediately, whereas the larger suite on the seventh floor will be vacant from the beginning of January. Rents include service charges but [3] utilities. A viewing can be arranged at your convenience, and I would be [4] to answer any questions you may have beforehand.

Best regards,
Daniel Osei
Leasing Manager, Riverside Plaza

questions.explanation: 'namely' introduces the specification of the two suites.

choices: Riverside Plaza is located beside the river, opposite the central station and a short walk from the main shopping street.
The details of each suite are set out below, together with the monthly rent and the terms of the lease.
Several of our current tenants are law firms and technology companies that have been with us for many years.
The building was awarded an environmental certificate last year in recognition of its efficient use of energy.
questions.explanation: The next sentences give details of the suites, so the preceding sentence introduces them.
'include ... but exclude utilities' requires a parallel base-form verb.
'I would be delighted to' is a standard polite formula.

text:
ATTENTION: PARKING GARAGE USERS

The underground garage at Meridian Tower will be closed for resurfacing from Friday at 6 p.m. until Monday at 6 a.m. [1] During this period, tenants holding permits may park in the Albion Street lot, which is a three-minute walk from the main entrance. [2] Vehicles remaining in the garage after 6 p.m. on Friday will be towed at the owner's expense. [3] , deliveries to the loading dock will be unaffected, since the dock is reached by a separate ramp. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your [4] while the work is carried out. Inquiries may be addressed to the building manager.

choices: The work is necessary to repair damage caused by water that has gradually seeped through the concrete.
The tower was built in 2004 and houses the offices of more than forty companies on twenty-two floors.
The garage has space for about three hundred vehicles and is open around the clock throughout the year.
The building manager is considering adding charging points for electric cars on the lowest level.
questions.explanation: The sentence explains the reason for closure before the practical arrangements.

choices: The Albion Street lot has been used by the building in the past, so no extra permits will be required.
Tenants are therefore asked to remove their vehicles before the closure and not to leave any belongings behind.
Bicycle racks are located by the main entrance and will remain accessible throughout the weekend.
Cleaning of the lobby will be carried out on Saturday morning and will not affect access to the building.
questions.explanation: The next sentence says vehicles remaining will be towed, so the preceding sentence requests removal.
The sentence introduces what is not affected: a contrast with the garage closure.
'patience' means tolerance; 'patients' is a homophone distractor.

text:
To: Sales Associates
From: Ethan Park, Store Manager
Subject: Holiday schedule

As the holiday season approaches, we expect customer traffic to rise sharply. [1] To ensure that the store is adequately staffed, all associates will be required to work at least two weekend shifts in December. [2] Requests for time off must be submitted in writing by November 10, and those received after this date will be considered only if cover can be arranged. Part-time employees will be offered additional hours, [3] full-time staff will be paid overtime when they work more than forty hours. Please [4] that the store will remain open until 10 p.m. on the three Fridays before the holiday.

choices: Last year, sales in December accounted for nearly a third of our total revenue for the entire year.
The store has been redecorated for the season, and the window displays will be changed at the beginning of next week.
Our supplier has promised to deliver additional stock to cover the expected increase in demand for gift items.
Several new part-time employees have been recruited and will receive training during the first week of the month.
questions.explanation: The next sentence tells staff what is required, so the preceding sentence explains why.
'Accordingly' introduces the consequence of the staffing needs.
'whereas' contrasts the arrangement for part-time and full-time staff.
'Please note that' is the standard formula.

text:
Nomination Form – Employee of the Year Award

Any employee may nominate a colleague for the Employee of the Year Award, with the exception of members of the selection committee. [1] Nominations must describe, in no more than 300 words, the specific contributions that make the nominee deserving of recognition. [2], evidence such as customer comments, performance data, or examples of improved processes will strengthen the nomination. The committee will give priority to achievements that have [3] a measurable benefit to the company. [4] a nominee is not selected in one year, he or she may be nominated again in the following one. Completed forms should be returned to the Human Resources office by December 1.

choices: Only staff who have completed at least twelve months of service by the closing date are eligible to be nominated.
The winner will receive a certificate, a financial prize, and a day of paid leave to be taken at their convenience.
Last year's award was presented to a member of the logistics team at the annual dinner in the new year.
The selection committee consists of six members drawn from different departments and meets four times a year.
questions.explanation: The next sentence is about nominations, so the preceding sentence is about who may be nominated.
'Where possible' is a fixed expression meaning whenever it is possible.
Achievements 'produce' a measurable benefit; the others do not fit.
'Even if a nominee is not selected' concedes the failure and adds that renomination is possible.
